mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with meprobamate (CNS depressant) causes additive CNS depression and potential serotonergic potentiation, with meprobamate also metabolized via pathways that may be affected by MAO inhibition.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if combination necessary, use lowest meprobamate doses with close monitoring for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and hypertensive episodes.
